description: This file defines a Spring configuration class 'CorsConfig' that sets up CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) settings for the backend. It creates and registers a CorsFilter bean allowing specific origins, methods, and headers to enable cross-origin requests from Android emulators and local development environments.

classes.name: CorsConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that sets up CORS filter for specified origins and methods.

methods.name: corsFilter
methods.description: Creates and returns a CorsFilter bean configured with allowed origins, methods, headers, and exposed headers.
